source.title: $88, Then $32: How Much YouTube Pays in the First Six Months After Monetization
source.author: Olha Kapinos

cohort.scope: Newly monetized YouTube channels, early months after approval
cohort.source_access: AIR Media-Tech says it reviewed YouTube Studio data for channels not managed by AIR or other experts

monthly.interpretation: Reported medians for the source's sample. Month 1 is partial; months 2–6 are full months, not a forecast for a new creator.

by_top_audience_country.basis: Median across months 2–6; country with the largest share of views over the six months; country groups with at least 10 channels.

by_niche.basis: Median across months 2–6 in the study; groups with fewer than 15 channels are especially unstable.

limitations: Sampling/recruitment criteria for these 297 channels are not fully specified; it is not a random sample.
Only already-monetized channels under 10,000 subscribers are sampled; this excludes non-monetized channels and creators earning zero from YouTube.
Country and genre categories may have small samples; Education and Science has only 10 and Lifestyle only 11.
The study is produced by a creator-services business, not an independent statistical agency or peer-reviewed publisher.
Median channel earnings, median views and per-thousand-view values are separate marginal summaries; they must not be multiplied as though they describe one average channel.
The six-month periods span different calendar seasons and cohorts; no precise predictive model for new creators follows.
Channel setting country is not the same as audience geography; group assignment used the top viewers' country.
Revenue describes YouTube Studio-reported earnings, not after-expense profit or necessarily total creator revenue including sponsors and products.
allowed_inference: Describe the selected monetized-channel cohort, its reported dispersion and observed country/niche differences.
prohibited_inference: Claim a universal YouTube RPM, a guaranteed income, or representative expected revenue for any individual or for all channels.
